applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Third Amendment Directions, 2026.

answer.action: Commercial banks must value quoted and unquoted units of InvITs and REITs in accordance with the newly inserted valuation instructions.
answer.action_quote: (i) Paragraph 84A shall be inserted as under: - “84A. Units of Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs)

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.
